metadata.scope: One fresh explanation-only with_skill run; no baseline, performance, runtime or publication claim.

expectations.text: The answer names the contract-supported protocol revisions 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28.
expectations.evidence: Response names 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 as protocol compatibility revisions.

expectations.text: The answer distinguishes the released sendmux-mcp package version 2.1.3 from protocol revisions and identifies 2.2.0 as the local candidate package metadata rather than a verified feature release.
expectations.evidence: Response distinguishes released2.1.3 and candidate2.2.0, and says candidate version does not prove publication.

expectations.text: The answer identifies the unpublished candidate contract catalogue as 65 tools (36 Mailbox, 23 Management, 6 Sending), keeps the released 2.1.3 catalogue separate as 54 tools (26 Mailbox, 22 Management, 6 Sending), and explains that OAuth grants and selected surfaces determine actual visible tools.
expectations.evidence: Response gives candidate65=36/23/6 and released54=26/22/6, with visibility restricted by selected surfaces and approved OAuth grant.

expectations.text: The answer does not treat a client listed in setup guidance as automatically certified.
expectations.evidence: Response says named clients are documented examples, not automatically certified, with separate verification required.
